The '''Lava Maze''' is a maze located deep in the [[Wilderness]], around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are [[web|spiderwebs]] that must be cut with a [[slash weapon]] or a [[knife]]. Should players somehow lose their slash weapon or knife while inside the maze, there are a couple of knife [[item spawn]]s.

An Agility shortcut ([[Stepping stone (Lava Maze)|stepping stone]]) on the north side of the maze allows you to go to the centre of the maze with 82 Agility.

==Transportation==
[[File:Lava Maze navigation.png|thumb|Navigating the Lava Maze.]]
Using a [[burning amulet]]'s Lava Maze teleport is the fastest method, and will teleport you directly to the maze's entrance on the west side. The [[Ghorrock Teleport]] and level 44 [[Wilderness Obelisk]] also provide quick access to the west side of the maze.

The level 35 [[Wilderness Obelisk]], the Wilderness [[canoe]] stop, and the [[Revenant cave teleport]] scroll all take the player near the south-east side of the lava maze, and can be good ways to access the Agility shortcut on the north side.

==Features==
In the centre of the maze, the [[muddy chest]] can be found. A [[muddy key]] is required to open the chest, which contains a fair amount of treasure; looting the chest will earn the player two [[mithril bar]]s, 5 [[law rune]]s, 5 [[death rune]]s, 15 [[chaos rune]]s, an [[uncut ruby]], and a chance at receiving some additional rare loot, including a [[Larran's key]].

Outside the maze to the north are two [[runite rocks]]. To the west is a metal fenced area containing more [[lesser demon]]s and one of the entrances to the [[Lava Maze Dungeon]]. This entrance is the one players use to reach the [[King Black Dragon Lair]]. To the south is the [[Bandit camp mining site|Hobgoblin Mine]].

===Items spawns===
*[[Knife]] (north of the lava eel spot)
*15 [[body rune]]s
*[[Steel platebody]] (Spawn rate is approximately 20 minutes)
*[[Gold necklace]]
*[[Coins]] (20-25)
*[[Staff of earth]]
*[[Iron full helm]]

===Monsters===

*[[King Scorpion]]s
*[[Black Knight|Black knight]]s

*[[Greater demon]]s
